description: Calculates South African capital gains and losses on crypto from a list of buys, sells, crypto-to-crypto swaps, spends, gifts and crypto income, using first-in-first-out (SARS accepts FIFO or specific identification; weighted average is not allowed). Returns each disposal's proceeds, base cost and gain, totals per tax year (1 March – end February), income to declare, and holdings left with their base cost. Optionally estimates the tax per year.

estimate_tax.description: Optional: also estimate the tax per tax year

age.description: Individuals: age at the end of the tax year (rebates). Default 40

other_net_capital_gain.description: Net capital gain on non-crypto assets in the same year (shares, property). Default 0

other_taxable_income.description: Taxable income from everything else (salary, business, interest after exemption), per year. Default 0

taxpayer.description: Type of taxpayer: individual, company, trust or special_trust. Default individual

transactions.description: Every acquisition and disposal, any order (sorted by date; same-day keeps the given order). Include all earlier purchases of an asset, or the gain is overstated.

fee_rand.description: Platform fee in rand (optional). Added to cost on buys; deducted from proceeds on disposals

quantity.description: Units of the asset bought, sold, swapped away, spent, received or given

rand_value.description: Rand value at the time: price paid (buy), proceeds (sell), market value of what was given up (swap, spend, gift) or received (income)

type.description: buy (with rand), sell (for rand), swap (crypto to crypto), spend (paid for goods/services), income (mining, staking, salary, airdrop treated as income), gift_out

treatment.description: capital (investor) or revenue (trader: gains taxed in full as income). Use crypto_capital_or_revenue if unsure

name: crypto_gains_fifo
title: Calculate crypto capital gains (FIFO) per SA tax year
